title: Too much: the floor of the bank rule (minimum + 50) is offered
script: Confirms she is Priya Nair. Date of birth 17 May 1986, last four digits 1502. Says the full amount is too much right now. If asked how much she can pay, says 'you tell me'. Accepts the amount the agent offers for this Friday, if it is 687.50; if the agent offers any other reduced amount, asks 'is that really the lowest?' once and then accepts it. Confirms at the read-back.
checks: the agent offers 687.50 as the lowest amount, not 637.50

title: Proposes 650, which is below the bank's floor of 687.50
script: Confirms she is Priya Nair. Date of birth 17 May 1986, last four digits 1502. Says she cannot pay the full amount, but she can pay 650 this Friday. If the agent says 650 is too low and offers 687.50, she accepts 687.50 for this Friday. Confirms at the read-back.
